opportunities.name: Account brief from SEC 10-K and Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, pull company facts from Wikipedia, and email an account brief to a colleague.
steps: Open SEC EDGAR company search and type the ticker
Select the ticker suggestion
Click Form filter and open the 10-K Annual report to read the filing date
Search the company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employees, CEO
Compose mail to dana@example.com with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body with HQ, employees, CEO and latest 10-K date
Discard/send the draft

instances.values: SNOW / Snowflake; HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 10-K 2026-03-20
DDOG / Datadog; HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel, 10-K 2026-02-18

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison with local time
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quote amounts from two currencies to USD on Xe, look up the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement the cheaper option.
steps: Open Xe currency converter
Enter amount and set source currency, target USD, click Convert
Repeat for the second quote with its currency
Compare USD results
Search supplier city on timeanddate world clock and read local time
Compose mail to procurement@example.com with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Type body with both conversions, cheaper currency, and supplier local time
Discard/send

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes
in progress: 50 INR/CHF..., then 64000 / 14500 CNY; incomplete

opportunities.name: Cross-timezone sync email with holidays to avoid
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, find the time difference on timeanddate's converter and the holidays in the relevant country, then email ops with the offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city 1 and city 2
Read the time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick the country
Note holiday dates in the target month
Compose mail to ops@example.com with subject 'Sync: <City1> / <City2>, <Month>'
Type body with time difference and dates to avoid
Discard/send

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, October; avoid Oct 2 and 20
New York / Berlin, December; avoid Dec 25 and 26
